title: Horizontal compatibility of the fixed ordinary finite tensor maps
statement: For every pair P,Q of integral cochain complexes, define the finite map from the vertical evaluation of ordinary coherent reduction of their total tensor to the evaluation of the tensor of their ordinary reductions by conjugating coefficientScalarTensorIso with pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex and coefficientEvaluationTensorIso, all from [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core] and [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Transport them to literal system evaluation by [lem-coef-tensor-reduction-evaluation-identification]. These explicit maps commute in every degree with every actual quotient transition, as maps linear over restriction of scalars. The statement has no K-flatness, flat-term, derived-localization, or existential chain-map conclusion.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6 and 0941; steps 1 and 2 of lem-coef-tensor-reduction-ordinary-model

proof.text: Apply the proved degreewise coherent lift theorem. Its explicit finite formula is definitionally tensorReductionFiniteComponent.f i. Thus for each i there is a genuine sequence-module map whose canonical evaluation is the prescribed component at every n.

The component formula for the mapped canonical-to-literal evaluation isomorphism and naturality of its inverse identify the literal evaluation of this map with tensorReductionSystemFiniteComponent.f i. Apply the transition commutativity field of sequenceToStrictSystemFunctor.map to this sequence-module map. This is exactly the required equation for every m<=n, including identity arrows. No flatness or boundedness is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; degreewise coherent lift from the explicit strict tensor cone, followed by canonical-to-literal evaluation transport and strict-system functoriality. Fully proved in Lean by H2.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorReductionFiniteComponents_compatible (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) :
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P, Q)
    let G := (pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let B := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
      (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)).obj (G.obj P, G.obj Q)
    ∀ (i : ℤ) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
      (tensorReductionSystemFiniteComponent l E W P Q n).f i ≫
          SheafOfModules.sequenceSystemTransition
            (coefficientSequenceCommRingSystem l E W) (B.X i) h =
        SheafOfModules.sequenceSystemTransition
            (coefficientSequenceCommRingSystem l E W) ((G.obj T).X i) h ≫
          (SheafOfModules.systemRestriction (coefficientSequenceCommRingSystem l E W) h).map
            ((tensorReductionSystemFiniteComponent l E W P Q m).f i)
